qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized Nutrition (Aptamil, Nutricia) commands high clinical switching costs and brand pricing power, but Essential Dairy & Plant-Based (>50% of revenue) faces severe private label substitution, keeping 10-year group ROIC sub-hurdle at 7-10%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Specialized Nutrition has pricing power, but over 50% of revenue resides in Essential Dairy & Plant-Based (EDP), which suffers volume erosion against grocer private labels when attempting to pass on cost inflation. 10-year historical GAAP ROIC of 7-10% fails the 12% threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Historical 10-year GAAP ROIC has consistently remained between 7% and 10%, well below the 12% hurdle. Essential Dairy & Plant-Based represents over half of sales and faces persistent private-label competition from European grocers. While Renew Danone has stabilized recurring operating margins around 13-13.4%, the substantial goodwill from historical acquisitions (e.g. WhiteWave) and inability to raise prices in dairy without volume loss prevents achieving a sustainable >12% ROIC.
